description: A two-flop synchronizer written as one component in two clocks (core-layer2 4.4): its step block writes q, in clk_b (period 17), and reads a, in clk (period 10). The trace is sampled at clk_b's edges (17, 34, ...). The periods are chosen so that no clk_b edge falls between t's write (edge 40) and its commit (edge 50); see conformance/README.md.
